name: Plymouth Orchards & Cider Mill
admission_model: Free admission and parking; products, wagon rides, and pumpkins priced separately.
notes: Certified-organic orchard with daily cider and donut sales, wagon rides, farm animals, pumpkin picking, live weekend music, event rentals, and structured school tours. The separate Red Shed retail outlet is not mapped as another destination.

name: Parmenter's Northville Cider Mill
admission_model: Free entry; food, beverages, and retail purchases priced separately.
notes: High-recognition urban mill with visible cider pressing, riverfront grounds, play equipment, weekend hot-food service, and an adjacent winery/brewery. No current structured school-tour offer was found.

name: Three Cedars Farm
admission_model: Free parking and general admission; maze, rides, pumpkins, and products are pay-as-you-go.
notes: Substantial autumn proposition with a five-acre U-pick pumpkin patch, seven-acre corn maze, hayrides, train and carousel rides, barnyard playland, country store, field trips, parties, cider, and donuts.

name: Obstbaum Orchards & Cider Mill
admission_model: Free general entry; U-pick, hayrides, and products priced separately.
notes: A 27-acre family operation with cider and donut production viewing, limited U-pick apple varieties, pumpkins, weekend hayrides, picnic space, hard cider and wine, and field trips. Smaller activity footprint and limited operating days constrain direct overlap.

name: Blake's Lyon Township
address: 61475 Silver Lake Rd, South Lyon, MI 48178
admission_model: Farm store is free to enter; paid Funland admission and separately priced U-pick, food, and beverages.
notes: Current operation at the former Erwin Orchards site, acquired and reopened by Blake Farms in 2022; Erwin is not listed separately. Offers U-pick, a large paid Funland, wagon rides, bakery and market, hard cider, food, events, camps, and school trips.

name: Dexter Cider Mill
admission_model: Free entry; products and hard-cider tasting priced separately.
notes: High-recognition riverfront mill focused on wood-pressed cider, donuts, baked goods, pantry retail, scenic seating, and a hard-cider tasting room. It lacks pumpkins, U-pick, a broad activity program, and a current school-tour offer.

name: Wiard's Orchards & Country Fair
admission_model: Country Store entry is free; online paid admission is required for Country Fair attractions and U-pick access.
notes: Full-scale paid fall destination with U-pick apples and pumpkins, wagon rides, corn maze, inflatables, miniature golf, animal feeding, food, bakery and store, and structured field trips.

name: Wasem Fruit Farm
admission_model: Free general entry; U-pick produce and store products priced separately.
notes: Working family orchard centered on U-pick apples, pumpkins and berries, with homemade cider, a broad donut range, farm-market goods, and prearranged school tours; fewer entertainment attractions than score-5 destinations.

name: Alber Orchard & Cider Mill
admission_model: Free general entry; picking, tours, wagon rides, products, and winery experiences priced separately.
notes: Heirloom-focused orchard with more than 100 apple varieties, sweet and hard cider, wine, pumpkins, orchard walks, hay maze, play area, animals, wagon rides, events, and educational school tours.

name: Long Family Orchard, Farm & Cider Mill
address: 1540 E Commerce Rd, Commerce Township, MI 48382
admission_model: Cider mill entry and parking are free; paid Fun Farm admission, with pumpkins, cannons, food, and products extra.
notes: Large weekend Fun Farm includes a corn maze, hayride, jumping pillows, play structures, pedal karts, slides, petting farm, pumpkin patch, cannons, food concessions, and extensive cider-mill retail. No current school program was found in official materials.

name: Franklin Cider Mill
admission_model: Free entry; food, beverages, and retail products priced separately.
notes: Iconic high-volume mill with visible cider pressing and donut baking, historic water wheel, river and ducks, weekend jazz, cider dogs, and a substantial Michigan-goods market. It lacks orchard picking, pumpkins, and structured school programming.

name: Yates Cider Mill
address: 1950 E Avon Rd, Rochester Hills, MI 48307
admission_model: Free admission and parking; food, rides, animal feed, and retail products priced separately.
notes: Prominent water-powered mill with trails, picnic grounds, animal feeding, pony rides, bakery, ice cream, weekend hot food, fudge, apple retail, and long seasonal hours. The Canterbury Village sales location is not separately mapped to avoid duplicating the Yates concept.

name: Goodison Cider Mill
admission_model: Free entry; products priced individually.
notes: Compact seasonal mill known for cider, donuts, pistachio and pumpkin breads, pies, candy, preserves, apples, and caramel apples. Official materials show a retail-led visit without a farm-activity or school-program component.

name: Spicer Orchards Farm Market & Winery
admission_model: Paid wristband for orchard/play access; separately priced maze, scenic rides, picking, food, and products.
notes: Year-round market and winery with extensive U-pick, pumpkins, bakery, fresh-pressed cider, playgrounds, animals, wagon rides, corn maze, food vendors, seasonal events, and reserved school and group tours.

name: Diehl's Orchard & Cider Mill
admission_model: Free parking and core play activities; hayrides, pony rides, pumpkins, food, and products priced separately.
notes: Traditional orchard destination with cider, donuts, pumpkins, free corn and hay mazes, playgrounds, picnic space, orchard walks, weekend rides, and food trucks. Official site explicitly states there is no U-pick apple program; no school-tour offer was found.

name: Jenny's Farm Stand & Cider Mill
admission_model: Free farm-stand entry; products and rides priced separately.
notes: Small farm-market experience with cider, donuts, produce, pumpkins, animals, hayrides, pony rides, and a seasonal straw maze. No maintained official website or current school program was found, so service claims rely on the current local guide listing.

name: The Frosty Apple
admission_model: Free farm-stand entry; products priced individually.
notes: Approximately five acres and 1,600 trees, selling pre-picked apples, pies, cookies, dried apples, and maple syrup for roughly ten fall weeks. No verified cider, donuts, pumpkins, U-pick, attractions, or school programming.

name: Wing Farms
address: 5335 Dexter Ann Arbor Rd, Ann Arbor, MI 48103
admission_model: Free parking, admission, and scheduled hayrides; pumpkins, cider, and farm products priced separately.
notes: A 205-acre working farm whose public autumn offer centers on U-pick pumpkins, gourds, cider, free weekend hayrides, and occasional events. It does not present an orchard, donuts, broad paid attractions, or school tours.

name: Blake's Orchard & Cider Mill
admission_model: Farm market is free to enter; paid Funland and separately priced U-pick, food, beverages, and events.
notes: Blake Farms' flagship 120-acre destination combines U-pick, pumpkins, extensive family attractions, school trips, bakery and farm market, grill, hard cider, events, and year-round programming.

name: Blake's Big Apple
admission_model: Market access is free; paid Funland and haunted attractions, with U-pick, food, and products priced separately.
notes: Distinct current Blake Farms location with U-pick, a 25-plus-activity Funland, school trips, pumpkins, food, bakery and market, plus major nighttime haunted attractions.

name: Westview Orchards & Winery
admission_model: Market and winery access is generally free; paid seasonal farm admission, U-pick, food, and products.
notes: Long-running multi-season agritourism destination with U-pick fruit and pumpkins, cider and bakery, farm market, family play and wagon activities, school tours, winery, food, events, and rentals.

name: Hy's Cider Mill
admission_model: Free general entry; U-pick and store products priced separately.
notes: Weekend-only traditional mill and apple U-pick with cider, donuts, pumpkins, and a modest family-oriented orchard visit. No current structured school program or substantial food service was verified.

name: Rochester Cider Mill
admission_model: Free entry; products priced individually.
notes: Seasonal mill with cider, daily donuts, pies and farm-market goods, plus pumpkins, a straw pyramid, and a petting farm. No U-pick or current school-tour program is advertised.

name: Porter's Orchard Farm Market & Cider Mill
category: orchard, cider mill, and farm market
admission_model: Free admission; U-pick, corn maze, hayrides, events, and products priced separately.
notes: Third-generation orchard with U-pick apples and pumpkins, cider and donuts, market, play area, petting farm, hayrides, corn maze, rentals, and educational orchard and mill tours.

name: Mueller's Orchard and Cider Mill
admission_model: Free market entry; maze, events, and products priced separately.
notes: Seasonal orchard store with cider, donuts, apples, pumpkins, a corn maze, and event barn. No current U-pick or school-tour program was verified in official materials.

name: Parshallville Cider Mill
admission_model: Free entry; mill products priced individually.
notes: Historic seasonal grist mill, also known as Tom Walker's Grist Mill, centered on cider, donuts, baked goods, and a scenic mill visit. It does not present a broad farm-activity or school-tour offer.

name: Apple Charlie's South Huron Orchards
address: 38035 S Huron Rd, New Boston, MI 48164
admission_model: Free general entry; U-pick, hayrides, food, and products priced separately.
notes: Full traditional fall offer with U-pick apples and pumpkins, cider mill and bakery, animal area, pavilion, hayrides, gift retail, hot food, weekend entertainment, and tours. The business's legacy website is intermittent, so current operating details should be reconfirmed before field use.

name: DeBuck's Family Farm
admission_model: Timed paid festival admission covers core attractions; pumpkins, premium activities, food, and retail are extra.
notes: A 40-acre event-led destination with a 20-acre pumpkin area, 15-acre corn maze, more than 20 attractions, food and specialty drinks, cider and donuts, seasonal festivals, and educational field trips.

name: Erie Orchards & Cider Mill
admission_model: Free market entry; U-pick, attractions, tours, food, and products priced separately.
notes: Approximately 70 production acres and a reported 100,000-plus annual visitors, with U-pick fruit and pumpkins, bakery and cider press, large store, corn maze, play and animal areas, wagon rides, festivals, food, and tours serving more than 10,000 participants annually.

name: Kackleberry Farms
address: 6421 N Stoney Creek Rd, Monroe, MI 48162
admission_model: Paid per-person festival admission; pumpkins, food, drinks, merchandise, and selected seasonal picking are extra.
notes: Admission-led festival with more than 30 activities, corn maze, hayride, animals, slides, jumping pillow, pumpkins, specialty food and drinks, cider donuts, country store, and structured school field trips. It overlaps heavily on entertainment but is not an orchard/cider-mill-led concept.

name: Kapnick Orchards
category: orchard, cider mill, and farm market
admission_model: Free market entry; U-pick, tours, rides, festival food, and products priced separately.
notes: Year-round farm market with its own bakery and cider mill, fall U-pick apples and pumpkins, school tours, Enchanted Forest wagon rides, animals, and a major annual Apple Festival with food and entertainment.

name: Bennett's Orchard & Broken Barrel Hard Cider
admission_model: No admission charge; U-pick, food, cider tasting, and products priced separately.
notes: Family orchard with U-pick apples, pumpkins, weekend donuts, sweet-cider pressing, a country store, giant straw pile, food trucks, and an on-site hard-cider tasting room. No current structured school program was verified.
